summary: Asset Trust & Provenance implemented and ENFORCED end to end. Canonical flow wired: acquire -> content scan -> provenance -> trust decision -> quarantine/approve -> publish. The gateway's acquire NEVER returns RESOLVED without an APPROVE verdict: UNKNOWN license, unverified checksum or unverified commercial use => QUARANTINED (never usable); REJECTED license or embedded executable/script/add-on/traversal payload => REJECTED. AssetResolutionStatus.QUARANTINED added; AssetTrustEvidence/AssetTrustVerdict/AssetTrustPort in core; AcquiredAsset carries fail-closed trust evidence; MediaAssetTrustGate (AssetContentScanner + AssetTrustEnforcer) composed in the worker root; workflow RENDER_ASSETS fails closed when any pending asset is quarantined. 15 integration tests + 19 unit tests cover the negative matrix: quarantine fail-closed, SSRF private IP + DNS rebinding, malicious redirect, fake MIME, zip bomb, archive path traversal, credential redaction, conversion lineage, human-review-only promotion.

flow.acquire: AssetResolver.acquire -> adapter (content hash computed from received bytes) -> AcquiredAsset(trust evidence)
flow.content_scan: MediaAssetTrustGate -> AssetContentScanner (static; embedded executable/script/add-on, zip-bomb magic, archive traversal — never executes/extracts)
flow.provenance: AssetProvenanceService build_record / record_derivation (source_author, tool/model/prompt_hash/seed, generation_receipt, derived_from_hash, normalization_receipt)
flow.trust_decision: AssetTrustEnforcer.decide — UNKNOWN/proprietary license without human review, unverified checksum, unverified commercial use, trademark/attribution without approval => QUARANTINE; REJECTED license => REJECT
flow.quarantine_approve: QUARANTINED -> APPROVED only via promote_from_quarantine with a fresh human review record + evidence (metadata alone never auto-approves)
flow.publish: only APPROVE surfaces as AssetResolutionStatus.RESOLVED with the content-addressed ReferenceAsset
